hook_line: JAILER 2 INDIA GROSS HITS RS 462.75 CRORE

news_summary: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 collected Rs 8.75 crore gross in India on its second Tuesday, down 20 percent, taking its India gross to Rs 462.75 crore, according to Pinkvilla.
payoff: On course for a second-week close near Rs 480 crore in India.
